cohort_definition: Official Leopoldina members assigned to Class I (Mathematics, Natural Sciences and Engineering), Class II (Life Sciences), or Class III (Medicine), with election/admission year through 2025. Class IV is excluded. 2026 elections are excluded. No honorary/non-ordinary membership category was encountered in the frozen Class I-III detail-page cohort.
source_method: The official member-directory landing page exposed class and election-year facets but pagination queries were blocked by the site's WAF from GitHub Actions. The roster was therefore enumerated with official POST filters for Class x election year. Every bucket was required to return exactly its official facet total and never exceed 50 rows. The resulting immutable URL universe was then fetched at the official member-detail pages in 16 shards.
membership_category_note: The official directory exposes Class, Section, Election year and Active/Historical facets, but no separate honorary-membership facet. Within the Class I-III cohort, no detail-page heading identified an honorary Leopoldina member. Individual official biographies describe Leopoldina affiliation as Member. If a future official source identifies a row as honorary/non-ordinary, it must be handled as a versioned provenance correction before hierarchy unblinding.
roster_stop_rule: Freeze the Leopoldina science-core roster at v1. DOB collection may proceed only against this immutable cohort. Reopen roster membership only for a newly identified official correction with independently auditable provenance, versioned before any hierarchy-study BaZi outcome analysis.
